decisive_items: prolonged His-ventricular (HV) interval of 75 milliseconds on first conducted beat, extending to 277 milliseconds on second conducted beat
PR interval prolongs between first and second conducted beats
Some P waves do not conduct to ventricles
response.rationale: C1 adds the specific HV interval finding, which is characteristic of infranodal block and confirms Mobitz Type II, while R5 only cites the PR interval and non-conducted P waves. C1 is more specific and complete.

rejected.why: Right bundle branch block is a finding, not the primary diagnosis.
Sick sinus syndrome is not supported; the findings indicate AV block, not sinus node dysfunction.
